title: The strong converse exponent of composable randomness extraction against quantum side information
summary: We find a tight characterization of the strong converse exponent for randomness extraction against quantum side information. In contrast to previous tight bounds, we employ a composable error criterion given by the fidelity (or purified distance) to a uniform distribution in product with the marginal state. Our characterization is formulated in terms of the club-sandwiched conditional entropy, recently introduced by Rubboli, Goodarzi, and Tomamichel.
